PowerShell(foreach \($n in @\('brandscape.media','brevo._domainkey.brandscape.media','mail._domainkey.brandscape.media','_dmarc.brandscape.media'\)\) { Write-Output "=== $n ==="; try { Resolve-DnsName -Name $n -Type TXT -Server 1.1.1.1 -ErrorAction Stop | Select-Object -ExpandProperty Strings } catch { Write-Output "\(no TXT record\)" } })

PowerShell(foreach \($n in @\('brevo._domainkey.brandscape.media.brandscape.media','brevo._domainkey.brandscape.media','zmail._domainkey.brandscape.media'\)\) { Write-Output "=== $n ==="; foreach \($t in @\('TXT','CNAME'\)\) { try { $r = Resolve-DnsName -Name $n -Type $t -Server 8.8.8.8 -ErrorAction Stop; Write-Output \("  {0}: {1}" -f $t, \(\($r | ForEach-Object { if \($_.Strings\) { \($_.Strings -join ''\) } elseif \($_.NameHost\) { $_.NameHost } }\) -join ' | '\)\) } catch { Write-Output "  $t : none" } } })

PowerShell(foreach \($n in @\('brevo1._domainkey.brandscape.media','brevo2._domainkey.brandscape.media'\)\) { Write-Output "=== $n ==="; try { Resolve-DnsName -Name $n -Type CNAME -Server 8.8.8.8 -ErrorAction Stop | ForEach-Object { if \($_.NameHost\) { "  CNAME -> $\($_.NameHost\)" } elseif \($_.Strings\) { "  TXT: $\(\($_.Strings -join ''\).Substring\(0,[Math]::Min\(80,\($_.Strings -join ''\).Length\)\)\)..." } } } catch { Write-Output "  \(not found\)" } })

PowerShell(foreach \($n in @\('brevo1._domainkey.brandscape.media','brevo2._domainkey.brandscape.media'\)\) { Write-Output "=== $n \(TXT via CNAME chain\) ==="; try { $r = Resolve-DnsName -Name $n -Type TXT -Server 8.8.8.8 -ErrorAction Stop; $t = \($r | Where-Object { $_.Strings }\) ; if \($t\) { foreach \($x in $t\) { $s = \($x.Strings -join ''\); Write-Output \("  KEY OK, {0} chars: {1}..." -f $s.Length, $s.Substring\(0,[Math]::Min\(60,$s.Length\)\)\) } } else { Write-Output "  CNAME resolves but NO TXT key at target" } } catch { Write-Output "  lookup failed" } })

PowerShell(foreach \($n in @\('mail.brandscape.media','brevo1._domainkey.mail.brandscape.media','brevo2._domainkey.mail.brandscape.media','_dmarc.mail.brandscape.media'\)\) { Write-Output "=== $n ==="; foreach \($t in @\('TXT','CNAME'\)\) { try { $r = Resolve-DnsName -Name $n -Type $t -Server 8.8.8.8 -ErrorAction Stop; $v = \($r | ForEach-Object { if \($_.Strings\) { \($_.Strings -join ''\) } elseif \($_.NameHost\) { "CNAME->$\($_.NameHost\)" } }\) -join ' | '; if \($v\) { Write-Output "  $t : $v" } else { Write-Output "  $t : \(none\)" } } catch { Write-Output "  $t : \(none\)" } } })
